description: Counts a patient's chuna sessions for the year (or accident) and flags when the 20-session annual limit is reached for HIRA-covered encounters.

inputSchema.kind: Which piece of the rule the case exercises: tLt (count/exhaustion computeds), z7t (parse HIRA cumulative count), q7t (merge HIRA lists), j7t (which insurer codes query the cumulative count), Z8 (HIRA query window), SFt (건보/급여 claim warning I0009), BFt (산재 claim warning I0009), addChunaGuard (blocking newly added chuna lines in the prescription editor).
inputSchema.now: Frozen wall clock (Asia/Seoul) used for 'today' comparisons; the client uses the device clock.
inputSchema.isElectron: true when running in the desktop app that can call HIRA directly (live lookup); false = web, uses the server-saved snapshot.
inputSchema.record: Current encounter: 보험구분 (건보|급여|자보|산재|일반), 기준일시 yyyyMMddHHmm, 보험조회 (자격여부 or 자보 사고접수번호/사고발생일자).
inputSchema.saved: Server-saved snapshot GET chart chuna patients → results.추나시술내역: { 진료일자별내역: [{ 진료일자 yyyyMMdd, 삭제여부 boolean, 본원여부 boolean, 조회결과.수가코드 }] }.
inputSchema.live: Live HIRA result: { 목록: [{ 진료일자, 삭제여부 'Y'|'N', 해당요양기관등록여부 'Y'|'N', 수가코드 }], 누적횟수: number|null } (누적횟수 from HIRA getChunaData.조회결과.추나횟수).
inputSchema.현재진료/추나누적횟수: SFt input; 추나누적횟수 is only passed when the live lookup succeeded (실시간조회여부 === true), else undefined.
inputSchema.현재진료/최근진료기록 (BFt): 산재 encounters with 진료처방[].수가코드; recent records are fetched from max(day-of-year, days since 재해발생일자, 730) days.
inputSchema.addChunaGuard: 보험구분, 추나횟수소진, 실시간조회여부, 조회시각, before/after prescription lists; output is the list kept plus UI notices.

openQuestions: Whether a session already approved at HIRA for the current encounter is included in 누적추나시행건수: if today's chuna was auto-submitted, the count already includes it, so the 20th session's own encounter shows I0009 (count >= 20). Confirm against the HIRA notice whether the limit is '20 approved' or 'the 21st is refused'.

산재 (BFt) counts the current lines plus prior lines and warns at >= 20, i.e. on the 20th session itself, while 건보 (SFt) warns when the prior cumulative count is already >= 20 (the 21st). Off-by-one difference between coverages; which is intended?
BFt counts prescription lines (each 40710/40720/40721/40730 line), not distinct days; two chuna lines on one encounter count twice.
자보 uses the same 20 constant over the accident-scoped list (UI shows n/20 and auto-approval refuses at 20), but SFt and the add-guard ignore 자보. Is there a 자보 chuna limit at all?
당일추나시술여부 compares rows against the device's current date, not the encounter's 기준일시; opening a past encounter evaluates 'today' as the real today.
When HIRA returns 누적횟수 = 0 the client keeps 0 (?? operator) even if the list has rows; is 0 from HIRA trustworthy?
Live list pagination can be truncated (잘림) after V7t=10 pages of 300; the client only logs a warning and may under-count.
In the web app (not Electron) the add-guard never blocks: it only warns, and SFt receives undefined so I0009 never appears.
